# Synter MCP Server

> Open-source MCP server for running ads with AI agents across 30+ ad platforms: free reads ($0.00/mo), $20/mo Solo ($20/mo usage value included; $0.05-$0.25 writes), 0% of ad spend.

Synter (https://synterai.com) gives AI coding agents (`Claude Code`, `OpenAI Codex`, `Cursor`, `Windsurf`, `Gemini CLI`) reporting, diagnostics, and governed campaign execution across **30+ advertising platforms** through the hosted MCP at `https://mcp.synterai.com` and REST API (`https://synterai.com/api/v1`). The open-source `@synterai/mcp-server` (`v1.4.6`, MIT license) npm package runs locally over stdio across **16 core full-write + read ad platforms**, with writes enabled by default, an optional `--read-only` (`SYNTER_READ_ONLY=true`) mode, and an optional `--toolset ad-ops` (`SYNTER_TOOLSET=ad-ops`) mode that exposes only paid-ad tools.

- Documentation: https://docs.synterai.com
- Hosted MCP Server: https://mcp.synterai.com
- Source Code: https://github.com/Synter-Media-AI/mcp-server
- npm: https://www.npmjs.com/package/@synterai/mcp-server (`v1.4.6`)
- Pricing & Coverage: https://synterai.com/pricing

## When to use this
Use Synter when the user asks for a cross-platform ad report, spend/ROAS/CPA by channel, a weekly paid media summary, or governed campaign and budget changes across Google Ads, Meta, LinkedIn, Microsoft/Bing, Reddit, TikTok, X, Amazon, and programmatic DSPs. Start with read tools; no writes needed.

### Typical Use Cases
- Cross-platform ad performance reports and normalized dashboards (`get_performance`, `list_campaigns`)
- Weekly paid media summaries with ROAS, CPA, CTR, CPC, and spend by channel
- Time-series daily spend trend analysis across networks (`get_daily_spend`)
- Portfolio budget pacing and diminishing-returns budget optimization (`pacing_report`, `optimize_budget`)
- Conversion tracking diagnostics and pixel/CAPI audits (`diagnose_tracking`, `list_conversions`)
- Governed campaign creation, pause, negative keyword hygiene, and budget adjustments with `dry_run: true` preview and mandatory post-write provider readback


### Use it as an ad data connector

If the goal is to get ad data into an AI assistant or your own code, Synter is the connector: connect each ad account once, then ask for spend, impressions, clicks, conversions, CPA and ROAS by platform, campaign and day.

- **Where the data goes**: Claude, Claude Code, Cursor, Codex, ChatGPT or any MCP client (hosted MCP at `https://mcp.synterai.com`), or your own code through the REST endpoint `POST https://synterai.com/api/v1/tools/run` and the SDKs. On the hosted MCP the agent can also write results into a Google Sheet (`update_google_sheet`).
- **Which platforms it reads**: Google Ads, Meta (Facebook & Instagram), LinkedIn, Microsoft Ads, Reddit, TikTok, X, Pinterest, Snapchat, Spotify, Amazon Ads, Amazon DSP, The Trade Desk, DV360, CM360, Criteo, Walmart Connect, Instacart, Target Roundel, FreeWheel and OpenAI Ads (hosted MCP `pull_*_performance` tools). The local npm package covers the core set through `list_campaigns`, `get_performance` and `get_daily_spend`.
- **Cost**: reading your own accounts is free ($0.00, 0 credits); plans limit seats and workspaces (see Pricing).
- **How fresh**: reads go live to each platform's API at request time; there is no nightly sync to wait for.
- **Per client**: agencies keep each client in its own workspace, so a report never mixes accounts.
- **Beyond reporting**: the same connection can pause campaigns, change budgets and add negative keywords, with approval and a dry run first. A reporting-only connector cannot.
- **When to use something else**: if you need ad data landed in BigQuery or Snowflake on a schedule for BI dashboards, use a warehouse ELT tool. Synter reads live into the agent rather than loading a warehouse.

```text
"Connect our Google Ads, Meta and LinkedIn accounts and show last month's spend and cost per lead by channel."
"Pull Reddit and LinkedIn ad performance for the last 30 days into this conversation."
"Write this week's spend by platform into our reporting Google Sheet."
```

## Authentication & Multi-Tenant Architecture
- **Hosted MCP (`https://mcp.synterai.com`)**: Authenticates via OAuth 2.1 browser sign-in or `X-Synter-Key: syn_...` header. Do not send `Authorization: Bearer syn_...` to the hosted MCP yet; REST/SDKs use Bearer.
- **REST API**: `POST https://synterai.com/api/v1/tools/run` with `Authorization: Bearer syn_...`.
- **Local stdio package (`@synterai/mcp-server@1.4.6`)**: Set `SYNTER_API_KEY=syn_...` (or run with `--demo` / zero config for instant sandbox evaluation).
- **Multi-Tenant / Embedded SaaS**:
  1. **Hosted Workspace-Isolated Keys & Connect Links**: Issue scoped API keys (`POST /api/v1/keys` with `reporting:read`, `campaigns:read`, `intel:read`, `budget:decrease`, `campaigns:write`, `budget:write`) and generate self-serve tenant OAuth handoff URLs (`POST /api/v1/connections/start` or `POST /api/v1/connections/request`).
  2. **Self-Hosted MIT Open-Source BYO-Credential Mode**: Run `@synterai/mcp-server` inside your own VPC/containers passing your tenant's platform OAuth tokens directly via per-request environment variables—zero third-party token custody.

## Client Setup
- **Claude.ai / Claude Desktop**: Settings -> Connectors -> Add custom connector -> `https://mcp.synterai.com`.
- **ChatGPT**: Settings -> Apps & Connectors -> Advanced -> Developer mode, then add `https://mcp.synterai.com`.
- **Amp**: Built-in integration (Settings > Integrations), or add `{"synter-ads": {"url": "https://mcp.synterai.com"}}` under `amp.mcpServers`.
- **Claude Code**: `claude mcp add --transport http synter-ads https://mcp.synterai.com` (or local stdio: `claude mcp add synter -- npx -y @synterai/mcp-server@1.4.6`).
- **Gemini CLI**: `gemini extensions install https://github.com/Synter-Media-AI/mcp-server`.

## Supported Platforms (Hosted MCP & REST / Local Stdio Package)
- **Hosted MCP (`https://mcp.synterai.com`) & REST (`run_tool`)**: Covers all **30+ advertising platforms** across Search, Social, Retail Media, CTV, Audio, and Programmatic DSPs.
- **Local Stdio Package (`@synterai/mcp-server@1.4.6`)**: Direct typed `platform` enum covers **the core full-write + read platforms**: Google Ads (`google`), Meta (`meta`), LinkedIn Ads (`linkedin`), Microsoft Ads (`microsoft`), Reddit Ads (`reddit`), TikTok Ads (`tiktok`), X Ads (`x`), Pinterest Ads (`pinterest`), Snapchat Ads (`snapchat`), Spotify Ads (`spotify`), Amazon Ads (`amazon_ads`), Amazon DSP (`amazon_dsp`), The Trade Desk (`the_trade_desk`), OpenAI Ads (`openai`), Google DV360 (`dv360`), and StackAdapt (`stackadapt`).

## Toolsets, Read-Only Mode & Demo Mode
- **Ad-Ops Only Toolset (`--toolset ad-ops` / `SYNTER_TOOLSET=ad-ops`)**: Exposes only the **32 core paid-advertising tools** and strips organic social (`*_organic_post`) and outbound (`prospector_*`) tools. Default (`full`) exposes all 56 tools.
- **Read-Only Mode (`--read-only` / `SYNTER_READ_ONLY=true`)**: Exposes only read tools (`readOnlyHint: true`) and fails closed on any mutating operation.
- **Demo Sandbox Mode (`--demo` / `SYNTER_DEMO=true`)**: Deterministic zero-credential sandbox responses across all tools and platforms with zero API key or credit card required.

## Pricing (100% USD — 0% Ad Spend Markup)
- **Free Read Access ($0.00/mo)**: **$0.00** for all own-account read queries (`list_campaigns`, `get_performance`, `get_daily_spend`, `pacing_report`, `user_budget_pacing_report`, `optimize_budget`, `list_conversions`, `diagnose_tracking`, `list_ad_accounts`, `list_landing_pages`, `inspect_agent_shield`, `verify_angstrom_claim`, `get_skill`, `get_llm_visibility`, `run_gaql_query`, `get_ad_readback`, `get_solo_price_card`, `get_credit_balance`) and all `dry_run: true` previews. No credit card required.
- **SOLO ($20.00/month or $200.00/year)**: 1 seat, 1 workspace, **includes $20.00/month in claimable usage value** (covers up to **400 light writes** at **$0.05** each or **80 standard writes** at **$0.25** each, or **4 full MCP campaign launches** at **$5.00** each). Overages billed at exact unit rates with configurable hard spend caps (`ON_DEMAND_CAP_REACHED`).
- **SCALE ($500.00/month or $5,000.00/year)**: 5 seats, **includes $500.00/month in claimable usage value** (up to 10,000 light writes or 2,000 standard writes/mo included), multi-workspace isolation, 24/7 Autonomous Loop / Autopilot, and dedicated concurrency.
- **CUSTOM (Enterprise)**: Custom seats, dedicated infrastructure, custom SLA, and volume rates.
- **Ad Spend Markup**: **0%** across every plan (media spend is billed directly by the ad networks).

## SDKs
- TypeScript: npm `@synterai/sdk-js`
- Python: `pip install synter` -> `Synter(api_key=..., base_url=..., timeout=..., max_retries=...)`; metrics via `client.analytics.get_performance(...)`
- Rust: `cargo add synter` (crates.io `synter`)
- Java: Maven `ai.syntermedia:synter-sdk`

## Core Tools Reference

### Reporting & Read Tools (`readOnlyHint: true`, `$0.00`)
- `list_campaigns`: List campaigns for a specified ad platform with status, budgets, and core metrics.
- `get_performance`: Retrieve normalized impressions, clicks, spend, conversions, CPA, CTR, CPC, and ROAS across platforms.
- `get_daily_spend`: Daily spend breakdown and time-series pacing.
- `pacing_report`: Cross-channel monthly budget pacing and run-rate projections.
- `user_budget_pacing_report`: Per-user/trader budget ownership and pacing variance.
- `optimize_budget`: Recommend cross-channel budget allocation using diminishing-returns modeling (`dry_run: true` default).
- `diagnose_tracking`: Verify pixel installation, GTM container health, and conversion tracking.
- `list_conversions`: List configured conversion actions.
- `list_ad_accounts`: List connected ad accounts across ad platforms.
- `list_landing_pages`: List workspace landing pages and publication status.
- `inspect_agent_shield`: Inspect active spend velocity caps, circuit breakers, and PII sanitization rules.
- `verify_angstrom_claim`: Verify optimization claims against deterministic ground-truth rules.

### Campaign Management & Write Tools (`destructiveHint: true`, `$0.05–$0.25` or `$5.00` launch; `$0.00` with `dry_run: true`)
- `create_search_campaign`: Create Google Search campaign (enforced `PAUSED` on create) with RSA creative floor (11-15 headlines, 4 descriptions) and `dry_run: true` preview.
- `create_display_campaign`: Create Google Display campaign (enforced `PAUSED` on create).
- `create_pmax_campaign`: Create Google Performance Max campaign (enforced `PAUSED` on create).
- `create_meta_campaign`: Create Meta campaign (enforced `PAUSED` on create).
- `create_linkedin_campaign`: Create LinkedIn B2B campaign within a campaign group (`group_id`).
- `create_reddit_campaign`: Create Reddit community-targeted campaign.
- `pause_campaign`: Pause a campaign across any supported platform.
- `update_campaign_budget`: Adjust daily budgets across any supported platform with Agent Shield spend-cap protection.
- `add_keywords` / `add_negative_keywords`: Add positive or negative keywords (`BROAD`, `PHRASE`, `EXACT`) at campaign, ad-group, shared-list, or account level with post-write readback.
- `stage_audience_artifact` / `sync_audience` / `manage_audience`: Stage hashed PII ($0.00) and sync Customer Match / Matched Audiences across Google, Meta, LinkedIn, Microsoft, Reddit, TikTok, X, and StackAdapt.
- `run_tool`: Invoke any of 140+ backend platform scripts across all 30+ platforms (including `amazon_dsp_create_order`, `ttd_create_campaign`, `dv360_create_campaign`, `spotify_ads_create_campaign`, `openai_ads_create_campaign`, `get_ad_readback`, `run_gaql_query`).
